label: Vakalatnama (authority to the advocate)

review.note: Fixed wording is a standard vakalatnama. It has not yet been reviewed by a practising advocate; some courts require their own prescribed form.

notes: Some High Courts and tribunals prescribe a particular vakalatnama form or court-fee stamp. Check the rules of the court where it will be filed.

slots.label: Name of the court
slots.example: Court of the Metropolitan Magistrate, Egmore, Chennai

slots.label: Title of the case
slots.example: M/s Sundaram Agencies v. M/s Kumar Traders Pvt Ltd

blocks.text: I/We, {{client_name}}, the {{client_capacity}} in the above matter, appoint and retain {{advocate_names}}, Advocate(s) (together the "Advocate"), to appear, act and plead for me/us in the above matter and in all proceedings connected with it, and to conduct, prosecute or defend it on my/our behalf.

I/We authorise the Advocate to file and sign applications, pleadings and documents, to take back documents, to appoint another advocate with my/our consent, and to receive money payable to me/us in the matter and give valid receipts for it.
I/We agree to accept as binding all acts done by the Advocate in good faith under this authority, and I/We shall not hold the Advocate responsible for any result of the case.
